name: Colorado Mountain Solar
old_description: At Colorado Mountain Solar, we believe that making the switch to solar should be simple, honest, and rewarding. We strive to empower our customers by providing sustainable, reliable, innovative, and personalized solar energy solutions for energy independence, while supporting the environment and contributing to our community.
about:
Colorado Mountain Solar is based in Buena Vista, Colorado, where it provides solar energy solutions for residential and commercial customers. The company focuses on making the switch to solar simple, honest, and rewarding.

The company designs, installs, upgrades, services, and maintains both grid-tied and off-grid solar systems, including roof-mounted and ground-mounted configurations. It incorporates battery storage and backup generators where needed, and offers system upgrades such as additional panels, new inverters, expanded battery storage, and updated monitoring. A System Care Program provides preventive maintenance, system optimization, and priority service, while pre-purchase inspections deliver a Solar System Health Report for property buyers.

Colorado Mountain Solar serves homeowners, business owners, and off-grid property owners across residential, commercial, and off-grid solar markets. It also supports real estate transactions with pre-purchase inspections. A customer testimonial from Stewart Legg describes rapid emergency repair for an off-grid system.

The company says it differentiates itself through customer-focused service, honest guidance, top-quality products, expert craftsmanship, and support that lasts long after installation. Its stated values are empowerment, sustainability, and excellence, and it commits to responding to estimate requests within two business days.
